name: careercampus
description: Gamified career roadmaps — React 18 + TypeScript, PHP 8.3 + Slim 4, PostgreSQL 16

scripts.setup: docker compose build && docker compose run --rm php composer install && docker compose run --rm php composer dump-autoload -o
scripts.migrate: docker compose exec -T php php bin/migrate.php
scripts.seed: docker compose exec -T php php bin/seed.php
scripts.test: npm run test:backend && npm run test:frontend
scripts.lint: npm run lint:backend && npm run lint:frontend
scripts.lint:backend: docker compose run --rm php vendor/bin/phpstan analyse && docker compose run --rm php vendor/bin/php-cs-fixer fix --dry-run --diff
